article.title: Interpretation
article.content:
264Interpretation

Article 264 · Part XII · General
In this Part, “Finance Commission” means a Finance Commission constituted under article 280.

1 Subs. by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 29 and Sch., for art. 264 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).
